title: Short-to-Long: Detached Features for Long-Horizon Value Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.30461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning useful representations from continually changing value targets remains a challenge in deep reinforcement learning. We study the temporal horizon of this supervision: smaller discounts make these targets less sensitive to distant bootstrap changes, but using them for behavior changes the control objective. We introduce Short-to-Long (S2L), which supplies a long-horizon behavior learner with features trained by smaller-discount source networks. Detached connections prevent the behavior value loss from updating the sources, allowing each source to follow its own value objective while the behavior discount remains unchanged. Across Atari, online continuous control, and offline continuous control, the approach yields aggregate performance gains, improving the paired terminal median on 40 of 57 Atari games. Matched Atari ablations support the roles of feature transfer, smaller source discounts, and gradient isolation. Fixed-trajectory

translated_title: 从短到长：面向长时程价值学习的分离特征
translated_abstract: 在深度强化学习中，如何从持续变化的价值目标中学习有用的表示仍然是一个挑战。我们研究了这种监督信号的时间视野：较小的折扣因子会使这些价值目标对远处的自举变化不那么敏感，但若直接用它们来驱动行为，则会改变控制目标。我们提出了Short-to-Long（S2L）方法，它为长时程行为学习器提供由较小折扣因子的源网络训练得到的特征。分离连接防止行为价值损失反向更新源网络，使每个源网络可以遵循自身的价值目标，同时行为折扣因子保持不变。在Atari、在线连续控制和离线连续控制任务上，该方法带来了总体性能提升，在57个Atari游戏中有40个提高了配对终端中位数。匹配条件的Atari消融实验验证了特征迁移、较小的源折扣因子以及梯度隔离各自的作用。
tldr: 提出S2L方法，通过梯度隔离的分离连接，让较小折扣因子的源网络为长时程行为学习器提供特征，在不改变控制目标的前提下实现长时程价值学习，并在Atari与连续控制基准上取得整体性能提升。
en_tdlr: Short-to-Long (S2L) supplies a long-horizon behavior learner with features trained by smaller-discount source networks through detached, gradient-isolated connections, improving long-horizon value learning without altering the control objective and delivering aggregate gains across Atari and continuous control benchmarks.
